title: FabricObservation v1 — one node's fabric standing over one window, as reported to the operator's door: messages sent, delivered, and dropped in window_seconds, every drop counted apart by named reason in dropped_reasons, messages throttled at its doors, gossip rounds it ran, whether its registry view stands converged (null when the node reports no convergence word), and the registry entries it holds; counts and names only, never payload content; simulated is a constant — an observation is an in-process report, not a hardware measurement (Y-064)
